author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (admin-config)

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Administrator signed in on the admin documentation lab; seeded Business User signed in to the Portal with a fresh emailed link.
Reviewer-created Contract and Matter destination types, Global Entity and User Fields, a Portal-listed fictional Entity, and three request types added in Settings.
scenarios.expected: A request type added in Settings shows No target and offers only Global Fields; the editor has no Target control. Description, turnaround, Required, order and deflection links save and appear on the Portal. A missing required answer is refused. Conversion carries attached answers, lists unattached answers under Does not carry, refuses a blank type, and never uses an archived configured type or another module silently. Archiving a request type removes its Portal card and form but keeps its Requests readable.
scenarios.actual: 12 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3 for the Administrator and the Business User. Add request type with Enter showed "Target: No target"; the editor had only Display name, Description and Target turnaround (business days). 36501 was refused with "Enter a whole number from 0 to 36,500 business days, or leave it blank."; 5 saved. The No target Attach field menu listed only "· global" Fields, while seeded Contract- and Matter-targeted types also offered their module Fields. Required and ArrowUp reorder persisted; Department is a required basic; a User Field's Required is disabled with "... can't be required. A requester cannot pick a person in the Portal."; an Entity Field's Required saved. An address without https:// was refused; an External address link and a Knowledge item link saved with per-form Placement, Edit and reorder. On the Portal both cards showed the description and "Estimated turnaround: 5 business days" / "0 business days", each form showed only its own Before you submit link, Fields showed in the configured order with "(required)", a missing Deal value was refused with "Deal value (USD) is required.", and the Entity Field offered only the Portal-listed Entity. Converting to a Contract refused a blank type with "Pick a contract type.", carried Deal value 125000 and listed Country under "Does not carry into the contract". With the configured Target type archived, conversion offered only live types, refused a blank type, and created a Contract of the chosen live type. Archiving a request type removed its card, sent its form address to /portal, kept R-52 readable, and Restore brought the card back. Remove deleted the links with no archive and the Knowledge Item stayed published.

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Legal Team Member signed in on the admin documentation lab in a separate browser context.
scenarios.expected: Negative check: the Settings pages for this article do not open and the configuration API refuses the call.
scenarios.actual: Role confirmed as legal_team_member from /api/v1/me. /settings/intake/request-types sent the browser to /settings/profile. POST /api/v1/request-types answered 403 ("You do not have permission to perform this action.").

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Business User signed in to the Portal with a fresh emailed sign-in link in a separate browser context.
scenarios.expected: Negative check: the Settings pages for this article do not open and the configuration API refuses the call.
scenarios.actual: Role confirmed as business_user from /api/v1/me. /settings/intake/request-types sent the browser to /portal. POST /api/v1/request-types answered 403 ("You do not have permission to perform this action.").

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Records were named DOC-029 admin-config. Organisation reminder lead times were changed during the run and restored to 30, 14, 7, 1, and On the day; this was confirmed after reload.

Earlier development runs of the same script (logs not kept) failed only on reviewer script errors and left extra DOC-029 admin-config records with other suffixes; walkthrough-r1.json reviewerNotes lists them.
Negative access checks used the seeded Legal Team Member (nadia.haddad) and Business User (jonas.weber), each in its own browser context; roles were confirmed from /api/v1/me.
The editor has no Target control, so the archived-target check set a reviewer request type's Target with PATCH /api/v1/request-types/<id> as a fixture; everything after that used the browser.
No seeded Entity in the admin lab is Portal-listed. The reviewer turned Portal-listed on for its own Entity for the check and off again afterwards.
Not checked: renaming and reordering request types, Department carry-through to the record, and what a turnaround of 0 displays after submission.
The external deflection link was checked by its address and target only; the external site was not opened.
